terms.title: Text message terms
terms.closingNumber: Reply STOP to any of our texts, or text STOP to {number}. You can also turn texts off on your account page.
terms.closing: Reply STOP to any of our texts. You can also turn texts off on your account page.
terms.footerAddress: {address}. When these terms change, the version number goes up; your consent record keeps the version you agreed to.
terms.footer: When these terms change, the version number goes up; your consent record keeps the version you agreed to.

signup.consent.message: Text me updates from {brand}. Message frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help, STOP to cancel. See the text message terms and privacy policy.
signup.consent.note: The SMS consent box's default text on signup forms. Keep the words of signup.termsWords and the privacy policy: they link to those pages.

signup.termsWords.note: The words of signup.consent that link to the text message terms page.

signup.invalidPhone: That doesn't look like a phone number. Pick the country, or start with + and the country code.
signup.phoneNeeded: Add your mobile number to get texts, or untick the SMS box.

prefs.texts.note: The switch beside each list in the preference center: texts for that list.

prefs.textsNote: Texts go to {phone}. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to any text to stop them all.
prefs.textsStopped: {phone} replied STOP, so texts are off. Text START to the number that texted you to get them again.

prefs.textsSave.note: The button of the Texts section on the website's account page.

prefs.textsConsent.message: Texts about {list} from {brand}. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help, STOP to cancel.
prefs.textsConsent.note: Kept as the exact consent text when someone turns texts on for a list in the preference center or on the account page (the consent record says which).

evidence.optedOut.note: the evidence ReputeCast records for a change of SMS consent made by a text: the contact's SMS consent card and timeline

evidence.textMessage.note: where consent was given or withdrawn: by a text message

evidence.confirmation.note: the text that asks a new number to confirm

evidence.preferenceCenter.note: where SMS consent was given or withdrawn: the subscriber's preference center

evidence.accountPage.note: where SMS consent was given or withdrawn: the account page of the workspace's website

webhook.sms.delivered.note: a webhook event, in Settings › Webhooks

webhook.sms.failed: A text failed, with the reason and the provider's own code.
webhook.sms.clicked: A person clicked a text's short link (link previews carry machine: true).
webhook.sms.opted_out: A number texted STOP: SMS consent withdrawn on every list.
webhook.sms.opted_in: A number texted START: the consents STOP removed came back.
webhook.sms.replied: A reply that isn't a keyword, with its text.
problem.pickList: Pick a list of this workspace.
problem.pickContact: Pick a contact of this workspace.
problem.pickMember: Pick a member of this workspace.
problem.pickProvider: Pick an SMS provider of this workspace.
problem.pickCatalog: Pick an SMS provider from the catalog.
problem.pickSenderOfWorkspace: Pick a sender of this workspace.
problem.pickTestNumbers: Pick test numbers of this workspace.

problem.countryCodes.message: Pick countries by their two-letter code.
problem.countryCodes.note: country codes such as US, GB, DE

problem.wentOutDuplicate: This campaign already went out; duplicate it to send it again.
problem.versionConflict: Someone saved a newer version of this text. Reload to see it.

problem.noAnswer.note: provider: an SMS provider's name (Twilio); answer: what the provider answered, as it came (503 Service Unavailable), or answer.none

problem.noAnswerRetry.message: {provider} didn't answer: {answer}. Try again in a minute.
problem.noAnswerRetry.note: provider: an SMS provider's name (Twilio); answer: what the provider answered, as it came (503 Service Unavailable), or answer.none

problem.phoneOrCountry.message: That isn't a phone number. Use the international format, like +1 312 555 0123, or pick the country.
problem.phoneOrCountry.note: +1 312 555 0123 is an example number: keep it

problem.phoneFormat.message: That isn't a phone number. Use the international format, like +1 312 555 0123.
problem.phoneFormat.note: +1 312 555 0123 is an example number: keep it

problem.phoneFormatUK.message: That isn't a phone number. Use the international format, like +44 7700 900456.
problem.phoneFormatUK.note: the route tester's; +44 7700 900456 is an example number: keep it

problem.notPhoneNumber.message: “{number}” isn't a phone number in international format, like +1 312 555 0123.
problem.notPhoneNumber.note: number: what was typed; +1 312 555 0123 is an example number: keep it

problem.notTextable: That isn't a phone number ReputeCast can text.
problem.evidence: SMS consent needs its evidence: the exact consent text, where it was given and when.
problem.futureConsent: Consent can't be given in the future.

problem.optedOutByText.message: This number opted out by text. Only the person can come back, by texting START.
problem.optedOutByText.note: START is the keyword people text: never translated

problem.removeReason: Say why the number can get texts again.

problem.fieldRequired.note: field: a connection field's label, as the provider names it (Account SID, API key)

problem.credentialsRejected.message: {provider} rejected these credentials. Check them and try again.

problem.credentialsRejectedToo.message: {provider} rejected these credentials too. Check them and try again.
problem.credentialsRejectedToo.note: replacing credentials that were rejected; provider: an SMS provider's name

problem.noNumberList.message: {provider} doesn't list its numbers through its API. Add a sender ID instead.

problem.notInAccount.note: value: a phone number or a sender ID; provider: an SMS provider's name

problem.senderIdFormat.message: A sender ID is up to 11 letters and digits, with at least one letter, such as ACME.
problem.senderIdFormat.note: ACME is an example sender ID: keep it

problem.senderExists.note: value: a sender ID (ACME); provider: an SMS provider's name

problem.senderInRoute.message: A route uses this sender. Change the route in Routing & rules first.
problem.senderInRoute.note: Routing & rules is the SMS tab's name

problem.senderIdNanp: Sender IDs can't be used in the US or Canada.
problem.rejectReason: Say why it was rejected: the carrier's reason.
problem.futureDate: The date can't be in the future.

problem.noAdapter.message: This build doesn't have the {adapter} adapter.

problem.noWebhookApi.message: {provider} can't register webhooks through its API: paste the address in its console.
problem.noWebhookApi.note: provider: an SMS provider's name; its console: the provider's own dashboard

problem.webhooksFailed.note: provider: an SMS provider's name; answer: what the provider answered, as it came, or answer.none

problem.providerInRoute.message: Routes send through {provider}. Change them in Routing & rules first.
problem.providerInRoute.note: provider: an SMS provider's name; Routing & rules is the SMS tab's name

problem.noProviderSender.message: None of {provider}'s senders can text {country} yet.
problem.noProviderSender.note: provider: an SMS provider's name; country: a country's name in the reader's language

problem.noSender.message: No sender can text {country}: add a route for it in Routing & rules.
problem.noSender.note: country: a country's name in the reader's language

problem.testNumberFirst: Add a test number in Routing & rules first.
problem.sendSettingsLocked: The campaign is scheduled or sent. Unschedule it to change when it goes out.
problem.futureTime: Pick a time in the future.

problem.insideWindow.message: Only times inside {window} are offered: quiet hours hold texts outside it.
problem.insideWindow.note: window: the hours texts may go out in, 09:00–20:00

problem.dateAndTime: Pick a date and a time.
problem.alreadyScheduled: The campaign is already scheduled. Unschedule it to change when it goes out.
problem.reviewChanged: The text, audience, routes or costs changed since you reviewed them. Look again and confirm.
problem.blocked: Scheduling stays off until every block is fixed ({count, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}}).

problem.confirmWarnings.note: warnings: the checks' keys, joined with commas (registration, time_zones)

problem.typeCount.note: count: the number of recipients, in digits as it's typed (1204)

problem.changedWhileSending: The campaign changed while you were sending it. Look again.
problem.unscheduleOnly: Only a scheduled campaign can be unscheduled.
problem.textsWentOut: Texts already went out: pause or cancel the send instead.
problem.pauseOnly: Only a send in progress can be paused.
problem.resumeOnly: Only a paused send can be resumed.

problem.tooEarly.message: Texts can't go out before 08:00 local time.
problem.tooEarly.note: as Routing & rules says it on the web

problem.tooLate: Texts can't go out after 21:00 local time. The window can be narrowed, never widened past 08:00–21:00.
problem.emptyWindow: The window ends after it starts.
problem.keywordFormat: A keyword is one word of letters and digits, up to 20.
problem.keywordDuplicate: A keyword can only mean one thing.

problem.keywordRequired.message: STOP and HELP can't be removed: carriers require them.
problem.keywordRequired.note: STOP and HELP are keywords people text: never translated

problem.confirmationText: Write the confirmation text, or turn it off.

problem.threshold.message: A threshold is a rate from {min, number, ::percent .0} to {max, number, percent}.
problem.threshold.note: an auto-pause threshold; min and max: 0.1% and 100%

problem.noProviderKeywords: None of your SMS providers answers keywords itself.

problem.requireYes.message: Asking for YES needs the opt-in confirmation text.
problem.requireYes.note: YES is the keyword people text: never translated

problem.countryTwice.message: {country} is in two routes. A country takes one route.
problem.countryTwice.note: country: a country's name in the reader's language

problem.pickFallback: Pick a fallback sender, or none.
problem.fallbackOther: Pick another sender as the fallback.

problem.fallbackRegistered.message: A fallback must be registered for the same countries: {sender} can't text {country}.
problem.fallbackRegistered.note: sender: a phone number or a sender ID; country: a country's name in the reader's language

problem.otherRoute: Pick the route every other country takes.

problem.domain.message: Enter a domain name, like go.acme.io.
problem.domain.note: go.acme.io is an example domain: keep it

problem.carriersAsk: Carriers ask for this section: it can't be empty.

check.quietWait.message: Quiet hours: texts go out {window} in each contact’s time zone; outside it they wait
check.quietWait.note: a badge in an automation's publish dialog; window: the hours texts may go out in, 09:00–20:00

check.quietSkip.message: Quiet hours: texts go out {window} in each contact’s time zone; outside it they’re skipped
check.quietSkip.note: window: the hours texts may go out in, 09:00–20:00

check.quietSome.message: Quiet hours: texts go out {window} in each contact’s time zone; outside it, {skips, number} of {steps, number} SMS steps skip the text
check.quietSome.note: window: the hours texts may go out in, 09:00–20:00; skips of steps: the flow's SMS steps that skip their text outside the window

check.noSender: No SMS sender yet: the steps skip their texts until one is set up

check.noRoute.message: No route covers {countries}: {count, plural, one {# contact there is skipped} other {# contacts there are skipped}}
check.noRoute.note: countries: countries' names in the reader's language, as a list (Ireland and Germany); count: contacts with SMS consent on the steps' lists

check.pending.message: {sender} isn’t approved yet in {countries}: {count, plural, one {# contact there is skipped} other {# contacts there are skipped}} until it is
check.pending.note: sender: a phone number or a sender ID (ACME); countries: countries' names in the reader's language, as a list

check.rejected.message: {sender}’s registration was rejected in {countries}: {count, plural, one {# contact there is skipped} other {# contacts there are skipped}}
check.rejected.note: sender: a phone number or a sender ID (ACME); countries: countries' names in the reader's language, as a list

check.notSupported.message: {sender} can’t send in {countries}: {count, plural, one {# contact there is skipped} other {# contacts there are skipped}}
check.notSupported.note: sender: a phone number or a sender ID (ACME); countries: countries' names in the reader's language, as a list

check.notRegistered.message: {sender} isn’t registered in {countries}: {count, plural, one {# contact there is skipped} other {# contacts there are skipped}}
check.notRegistered.note: sender: a phone number or a sender ID (ACME); countries: countries' names in the reader's language, as a list

check.allSenders.note: senders: phone numbers and sender IDs, joined with commas (+1 888 555 0142, ACME)

notify.pausedTitle.note: a notification's title; name: the campaign's name, never translated

notify.pausedSummary.message: {metric, select, failed {Too many texts failed} filtered {Carriers filtered too many texts} other {Too many people opted out}}: {value, number, ::percent .0} (limit {limitWhole, select, yes {{limit, number, percent}} other {{limit, number, ::percent .0}}}). {held, number} held.
notify.pausedSummary.note: an SMS campaign that paused itself; value and limit: the rate and its auto-pause threshold, 6.2% and 5%; held: the texts not sent yet

notify.budgetUsedBody.message: {month, select, 1 {January} 2 {February} 3 {March} 4 {April} 5 {May} 6 {June} 7 {July} 8 {August} 9 {September} 10 {October} 11 {November} other {December}}'s SMS budget is used up ({budget}). Campaigns can't start and SMS steps wait until someone raises it.
notify.budgetUsedBody.note: month: the month's number, 1 to 12, in the workspace's time zone; budget: an amount in dollars, $100.00

notify.budgetAlertBody.message: {spent} of {budget} spent on texts this month.
notify.budgetAlertBody.note: spent and budget: amounts in dollars, $80.00 and $100.00

notify.credentialsBody: {provider} rejected the credentials. Texts through {provider} are held until they're replaced.
notify.downBody: {provider} isn't answering. Texts through {provider} are held; ReputeCast retries every 2 minutes.
notify.backBody: {provider} answers again. Held texts go out inside each recipient's window.

notify.silentTitle.note: provider: an SMS provider's name; no delivery receipts came back from it

notify.silentBody.message: No receipts from {provider} for {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} while texts were sent. Check the status callback in {provider}.
notify.silentBody.note: the status callback is where the provider sends delivery receipts (Twilio's name for it)

notify.registrationApprovedBody.note: what: the registration's name as the provider gives it (a brand, a 10DLC campaign), else the sender; sender: a phone number or a sender ID

notify.registrationRejectedBody.note: what: the registration's name as the provider gives it, else the sender; reason: the carrier's reason, in its own words

audit.pausedReason.message: {metric, select, failed {Too many texts failed} filtered {Carriers filtered too many texts} other {Too many people opted out}}
audit.pausedReason.note: why an SMS campaign paused itself, in the audit log

audit.pausedSummary.message: {metric, select, failed {failed} filtered {filtered} other {opt_outs}} {value, number, ::percent .0} over limit {limitWhole, select, yes {{limit, number, percent}} other {{limit, number, ::percent .0}}} · {events, number} of {base, number} · {held, number} held
audit.pausedSummary.note: the audit log's line for an auto-pause: the rate, its limit, the failed texts of those with a receipt, the texts held

audit.budgetReason.message: The month's SMS budget is used up
audit.budgetReason.note: why an SMS campaign paused itself, in the audit log

label.copyOf.note: a duplicated campaign's name; name: the original campaign's name

link.expired.message: This link has expired. Short links in texts work for {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}.
link.expired.note: the page a short link from a text opens once it has expired, in the visitor's language

source.preferenceCenter.note: where an email subscription came from, on a contact's consent card after its date: 14 Oct 09:00 · preference center

context.confirmation.note: what a number was sent when it was suppressed, or a text on a contact's timeline: the text that asks a new number to confirm

answer.none.note: what an SMS provider answered a call: nothing at all

answer.unauthorized.note: what an SMS provider answered a call; 401 Unauthorized is the HTTP status, kept as it is

domain.unavailable.message: DNS checks aren't available on this server.

domain.points.note: target: the instance's host name, reputecast.acme.io

domain.other.note: domain: the short-link domain; cname: where its CNAME points; target: where it should point

domain.none: No CNAME found. DNS can take up to an hour.

code.providerList.note: why a number is on the SMS suppression list: the provider's own opt-out list; provider: an SMS provider's name
